property_summary: For every valid call sending exactly 10 ether when block.timestamp > pastBlockTime, the reference contract preserves some positive contract balance after the fallback (unless block.number % 15 == 0) — equivalently: there exists at least one admissible input (a block.number not divisible by 15 with the other preconditions) where the mutant drains the balance but the reference does not; the rule: when block.number % 15 != 0 and caller sends 10 ether with timestamp > pastBlockTime, the reference leaves address(c).balance >= 10 ether while the mutant leaves it == 0.
change_summary: Unconditionally transfer contract balance to msg.sender (remove the block.number % 15 check), changing state visible via subsequent calls due to balance change and any effect on pastBlockTime sequencing.
